_paulohwa: Day 9. The corporal put Lucien Paulohwa beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Lucien Paulohwa wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Lucien Paulohwa won a week of rum at cards from a lance corporal in R-R8. The lance corporal wants a rematch. A letter from home found Lucien Paulohwa before the night shift. Lucien Paulohwa folded it small and kept it close. Lucien Paulohwa got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 835. The men who came later will ask about it. Lucien Paulohwa's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-R8 with the rations. Lucien Paulohwa ate while listening to the revised orders.

A round came through the loophole Lucien Paulohwa was watching at R-R8 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Konrad Sebs of the Hegemony (@_sebs.c_). Lucien Paulohwa fired at a movement across the wire at R-R8. The man went down: Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina, gravely wounded. Lucien Paulohwa was killed at R-R8 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Konrad Sebs of the Hegemony (@_sebs.c_).
Marek Paulohwa had heard about Lucien Paulohwa's courage. At R-R8, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Across from R-R8, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Marek Paulohwa saw it. Felix "Tin" Euberitamini was grazed. A letter from home found Marek Paulohwa before the night shift. Marek Paulohwa folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Marek Paulohwa raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R8. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. A letter from home found Marek Paulohwa before the night shift. Marek Paulohwa folded it small and kept it close.
bapt.mollard: Zeno Mollard arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle. Orders came through: Zeno Mollard is a field cook now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a child's drawing of a horse.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at T-F11. Zeno Mollard was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz of the Concord (@obreezyz1).

Another member of the House of Mollard reached the line: Leopold Mollard. He asked where Zeno Mollard had slept, then chose a different corner. Leopold Mollard became a signaller today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Leopold Mollard tried to describe the smell of Oakmere and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Mollard. Leopold Mollard read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Leopold Mollard could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Leopold Mollard could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Mollard. Leopold Mollard read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Leopold Mollard washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Mollard. Leopold Mollard read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Leopold Mollard saved the last of the sugar for Gustav Bonie's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Gustav's birthday. It was a good day anyway. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Mollard. Leopold Mollard read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
caleb_1aws0n: Cyril "Ash" Aws arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a stub of a pencil and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Cyril "Ash" Aws found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. A letter from home reached Cyril "Ash" Aws before dusk. Cyril "Ash" Aws read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Cyril "Ash" Aws tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at N-F19 is up. Orders assigned Cyril "Ash" Aws to work as a chaplain. The first lesson began with what not to touch.
chase_reynolds_13: Nils Reynolds reached U-F10 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

A bullet went into Nils Reynolds's chest just under the heart at U-F10. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Cyril Drawtoss of the Hegemony (@drawtoss). Nils Reynolds fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Roland "Bones" Bengal was badly wounded. Nils Reynolds ate breakfast without a word. Nils Reynolds stood up to fix a loose sandbag at U-F10. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Cyril Drawtoss of the Hegemony (@drawtoss).

Oskar Reynolds came to the front because his older brother Nils Reynolds never came home. He carries a bullet that missed him. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Oskar Reynolds read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Oskar Reynolds polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. A letter from home reached Oskar Reynolds before dusk. Oskar Reynolds read it twice and slept a little easier.

Viktor "Button" Chasserant mended the hole in Oskar Reynolds's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Oskar says the patch is stronger than the trousers. A letter from home reached Oskar Reynolds before dusk. Oskar Reynolds read it twice and slept a little easier.

Isidor Patience and Oskar Reynolds both swear they saw a ghost at Verdel Ridge. Each says the other screamed first. A letter from home reached Oskar Reynolds before dusk. Oskar Reynolds read it twice and slept a little easier. Now serving as a rifleman, Oskar Reynolds discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
diegolavega_7: Dietrich "Rabbit" Diegolavega arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a tin whistle and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Dietrich "Rabbit" Diegolavega carried in Pip, who lied about his age to enlist. Pip kept asking whether his mother would be told. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In U-F22, Dietrich "Rabbit" Diegolavega listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Pip has a fever. Dietrich "Rabbit" Diegolavega sits with him after every shift and reads to him from a book with the last pages missing.
Dietrich "Rabbit" Diegolavega spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Pip was put on the hospital train today, alive. He gave Dietrich "Rabbit" Diegolavega a button from his tunic. Dietrich "Rabbit" Diegolavega wears it on his own.
glow4life21: Albin Life told the sergeant he was a glassblower. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In Q-F8, Albin Life listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Albin Life's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Albin Life wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Albin Life was hit in the forearm at Q-F8. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Ulrich Nshill of the Hegemony (@nshill429).
Albin Life is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
A second spoon disappeared. Albin Life searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
higher_god_of_superiority: After 11 days of war, N-F17 had a place for everything. On Day 11, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Jakub Superiority. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached N-F17 with the rations. Jakub Superiority ate while listening to the revised orders.

Jakub Superiority carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished. The transfer made Jakub Superiority a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
Jakub Superiority bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
Jakub Superiority spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
jarnvag_: Day 6: Karel "Brick" Jarnvag reached S-S10 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Karel "Brick" Jarnvag and Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. A letter from home found Karel "Brick" Jarnvag before the night shift. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag folded it small and kept it close.

Karel "Brick" Jarnvag wrote a letter for Tobias Avtomat's mother, because Tobias could not find the words. Tobias signed it. A letter from home found Karel "Brick" Jarnvag before the night shift. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag folded it small and kept it close.
Karel "Brick" Jarnvag started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."

The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag approved the method. A letter from home found Karel "Brick" Jarnvag before the night shift. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag folded it small and kept it close.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home found Karel "Brick" Jarnvag before the night shift. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag folded it small and kept it close.

Karel "Brick" Jarnvag's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point." The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag answered to number 410. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A round came through the loophole Karel "Brick" Jarnvag was watching at S-S10 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Otto Carlingiti of the Hegemony (@carlingiti).
The stretcher Karel "Brick" Jarnvag lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag is back at S-S10, and someone else is lying in that dent now.

Karel "Brick" Jarnvag read his diary from the start tonight and laughed at how frightened he was back then. Then he stopped laughing and wrote: "Still here." A letter from home found Karel "Brick" Jarnvag before the night shift. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag folded it small and kept it close.
john.spleena.iii: Day 9. The corporal put Casimir Iii beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Casimir Iii kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Casimir Iii polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. The clerk counted the names twice. Casimir Iii is number 689 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-C14, Casimir Iii listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A note came over the wire at the Ossuary Wood, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Roland "Spark" Nothing.' Casimir Iii sang louder.
Casimir Iii sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking.
Casimir Iii spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
khattabka_: Quentin Khattabka came up on Day 4 carrying news from Esterhaus. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Quentin Khattabka was made Lance Corporal. He celebrated by sleeping four hours in a row. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Khattabka. Quentin Khattabka read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Quentin Khattabka in the open at S-F3. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Cyril "Ash" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Quentin Khattabka was carried in at last. The worst has passed for Quentin Khattabka. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Quentin Khattabka looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A surgeon stopped at Quentin Khattabka's bed, checked the dressing and moved on without a word. He decided that was good news. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Khattabka. Quentin Khattabka read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The medical officer cleared Quentin Khattabka for duty. At S-F3, someone quietly moved a pack off his usual seat.

Quentin Khattabka spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Khattabka. Quentin Khattabka read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Quentin Khattabka added a leak above the man's head in pencil. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Khattabka. Quentin Khattabka read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F3. Quentin Khattabka was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Felix "Tin" Jtall of the Hegemony (@jtall_680).

Another member of the House of Khattabka reached the line: Jakub Khattabka. He asked where Quentin Khattabka had slept, then chose a different corner. Jakub Khattabka left the work of a rifleman to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

A round went through the rim of Jakub Khattabka's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Dorian Caleb of the Hegemony (@ya_man_caleb). Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub Khattabka. Jakub Khattabka read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jakub Khattabka answered to number 290. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Jakub Khattabka wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Back on the fire step at S-F3. Jakub Khattabka says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
The gun at S-F3 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Jakub Mccooper, grazed.
Jakub Khattabka was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-F3. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Arno "Tin" Ryukov of the Hegemony (@ryukov46).
lilneftrappin: On Day 9, Severin Lilneftrappi arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Severin Lilneftrappi during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Bram Landonbuttva's name scratched on it. Severin Lilneftrappi kicked it back. It did not come again. Grey Mill has been won. Severin Lilneftrappi listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A bullet found Severin Lilneftrappi at S-R12, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Arno Olie of the Concord (@olie300). Severin Lilneftrappi was killed on watch at S-R12. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Arno Olie of the Concord (@olie300).
Karel Lilneftrappi had heard about Severin Lilneftrappi's courage. At S-R12, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Karel Lilneftrappi found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: an old man with a dog, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Karel Lilneftrappi of the Hegemony lost a cap on a night patrol near Verdel Ridge. Dorian Joshgentile of the Concord found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.
lord_punchworth: Karel Punchworth unpacked a tin of tobacco at R-F22. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Karel Punchworth tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F22 is up. A letter from home found Karel Punchworth before the night shift. Karel Punchworth folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F22. Karel Punchworth has learned to walk bent double.

Someone asked Karel Punchworth to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. A letter from home found Karel Punchworth before the night shift. Karel Punchworth folded it small and kept it close.

Karel Punchworth censored the men's letters tonight. He crossed out the place names and left in all the love. A letter from home found Karel Punchworth before the night shift. Karel Punchworth folded it small and kept it close.
Karel Punchworth checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.

Leopold Mrsmidgeyt of the Hegemony lost a cap on a night patrol near the Chalk Pits. Karel Punchworth of the Concord found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays. A letter from home found Karel Punchworth before the night shift. Karel Punchworth folded it small and kept it close.
Karel Punchworth was on watch at R-F22 when the night raid hit. The men found Karel Punchworth at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Norbert Sanocfc of the Hegemony (@sanocfc).

Teodor Punchworth arrived carrying the family name of Karel Punchworth. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. Teodor Punchworth transferred to the runners. The men in R-F22 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Teodor Punchworth was hit in the foot through his boot at R-F22. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Isidor Shitsherlock of the Hegemony (@_no.shitsherlock_). A single shot at R-F22. Teodor Punchworth sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Isidor Shitsherlock of the Hegemony (@_no.shitsherlock_).

Silas Punchworth put a tin of tobacco beside the bunk. Someone who had known Teodor Punchworth helped clear the shelf without saying why. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Silas Punchworth is number 328. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Silas Punchworth helped stack spare sandbags at R-F22. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Silas Punchworth was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F22. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Gustav Karter of the Hegemony (@just_karter_k). Silas Punchworth looked over the parapet at R-F22 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Gustav Karter of the Hegemony (@just_karter_k).
Marek Punchworth joined R-F22 under the shadow of Silas Punchworth's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Marek Punchworth kept Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Marek could have walked there blind. A letter from home found Marek Punchworth before the night shift. Marek Punchworth folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit Marek Punchworth's belt buckle at R-F22 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. A letter from home found Marek Punchworth before the night shift. Marek Punchworth folded it small and kept it close.
masterofeclipse: Severin Masterofecli arrived at R-R11 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Severin Masterofecli fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Florian Nuggets, now grazed. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Severin Masterofecli wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' Mail came up the line with a letter for Severin Masterofecli. Severin Masterofecli read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Severin Masterofecli reached up to fix a sandbag at R-R11 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Gustav Patriot of the Hegemony (@authentic.indonesian.patriot). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Severin Masterofecli answered to number 826. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-R11, Severin Masterofecli listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Severin Masterofecli walked back up the communication trench to R-R11, slower than before, but on his own feet.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at the Ossuary Wood, Severin Masterofecli was promoted to Lance Corporal.
In reserve, Severin Masterofecli slept nine hours in a barn. He dreamt of nothing, which was the best part.
micro_sergio: The new rifleman is Jakub "Whistle" Sergio, once a postman from Halden. The corporal asked if a postman was any use in a trench. Jakub "Whistle" Sergio said he would find out.

On dawn watch at S-C6, Jakub "Whistle" Sergio fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Yann Somosmagios, now grazed. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Jakub "Whistle" Sergio watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Jakub "Whistle" Sergio aimed a step ahead and fired: Dorian "Saint" Dallas, grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jakub "Whistle" Sergio answered to number 670. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Jakub "Whistle" Sergio read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Jakub "Whistle" Sergio held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Jakub "Whistle" Sergio read a theatre review while peeling supper.
Jakub "Whistle" Sergio traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
miked8903: The quartermaster asked Jonas Miked to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Jonas Miked helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Jonas Miked and Nils Makinekivanc carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
A bullet found Jonas Miked at R-F8, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Severin Sky of the Hegemony (@the_ghost_of_sky).

Jonas Miked drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Jonas Miked watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
There was never a bed for Jonas Miked, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F8 on his own feet.
Jonas Miked and Bastian Szko tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
A bullet grazed Jonas Miked's ribs at R-F8. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Teodor Shadowizard of the Hegemony (@shadowizard__).
Jonas Miked no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Jonas Miked helped stack spare sandbags at R-F8. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Jonas Miked pulled Zeno Franzcalamar out of a flooded shell hole at the Chalk Pits. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jonas Miked is number 104. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Jonas Miked kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Jonas Miked waited for that to change. When it did, Pavel Finnius was badly wounded.
Jonas Miked of the Concord and Albin Mit of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Hanging Bridge for a week. Both trenches keep score.
Jonas Miked's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
rankine_459.67: Dietrich Rankine came from Stoneyford, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

At R-C13 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Dietrich Rankine won the bet. Dorian Fuadhekal was grazed. Blackwater Canal has been won. Dietrich Rankine listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Dietrich Rankine noticed regular flashes from a broken chimney. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dietrich Rankine is number 896. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Dietrich Rankine helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Dietrich Rankine went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Dietrich Rankine worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Dietrich Rankine took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss, grazed.
saam_1z: Valentin "Spark" Saam was a brewer in Wyvern Cross until the posters went up. He came to R-S15 with a book with the last pages torn out, and within a day the whole squad knew that he keeps feeding the rats.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Valentin "Spark" Saam changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.

Across from R-S15, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Valentin "Spark" Saam saw it. Arno Zhar was grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Valentin "Spark" Saam helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Valentin "Spark" Saam was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Karel Zaza was gravely wounded. The clerk counted the names twice. Valentin "Spark" Saam is number 545 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Valentin "Spark" Saam helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-S15. Valentin "Spark" Saam fired at the last man to run. Benedikt Ghostrider was grazed.
The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Valentin "Spark" Saam approved the method.
Valentin "Spark" Saam fired at a movement across the wire at R-S15. The man went down: Benedikt Ghostrider, grazed.
schizophrenicwizard: On Day 11, Pavel Schizophreni arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Pavel Schizophreni watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Pavel Schizophreni had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Dorian "Spark" Cody, badly wounded. Pavel Schizophreni was hit in the foot through his boot at P-F6. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Norbert "Bones" Primum of the Concord (@salutem_primum_). A letter from home found Pavel Schizophreni before the night shift. Pavel Schizophreni folded it small and kept it close.
Pavel Schizophreni returned to P-F6 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Pavel Schizophreni felt a hard tug at his hip at P-F6. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. A letter from home found Pavel Schizophreni before the night shift. Pavel Schizophreni folded it small and kept it close.
zedsniperwolf2024: Benedikt "Parson" Zedsniperwol, a printer's apprentice from Marrow Fen, was sent forward on Day 12 to fill a gap in V-F4. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Benedikt "Parson" Zedsniperwol wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Benedikt "Parson" Zedsniperwol offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
